name: tabs

frames.best_why: Analytics is selected with its green panel large and centred and the cursor off the labels.

tagline: Pill tabs switch a stack of bright gradient panels with a spring.
summary: A row of four small pill labels, one filled to mark the active tab, above a large rounded gradient card. Clicking a label springs the highlight across and brings that card to the front of a shallow stack.
appearance: A row of four small pill labels on a black page, one filled grey to mark the active tab, with a wide rounded gradient panel below it holding a bold heading and one line of pale copy. Other panels sit behind the front card, slightly smaller and dimmer.
behaviour: Clicking a label springs the grey pill across to it and lifts that card to the front; hovering the row fans the stacked cards upward for a moment. The cards behind scale down and fade.
demo_content: Tabs Design, Development, Analytics and Settings, each showing a coloured card such as Analytics Tab.
search_phrases: tabs with a sliding pill highlight
stacked cards that change with tabs
pill tab bar with gradient panels
click tabs to swap colored card
product feature tabs with big cards
use_when: A short set of product areas where each tab deserves a large illustrated panel.
avoid_when: Content needs a set height: the absolutely stacked panels collapse without one.
customise: Pass a tabs array of title, value and content node; four className props tune the container, active pill, tab and content, while stacking offsets stay fixed.
weight_why: Four buttons and a few stacked cards driven by a single layout spring.

a11y.note: Tabs are plain buttons without tablist or aria-selected roles, and no focus-visible style is added.

issues: Stacked cards are so faint in frames 2 and 4 that they read as a smudged shadow.
No tablist or aria-selected roles for assistive tech.
Each tab's panel is a different bright gradient, so the component changes look entirely.
polish_why: Springy pill and layered panels are distinctive; the stacked cards read as faint shadows.
